feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 26 November 2026 10:40pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 26 November 2026 at 10:40pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong Winds, with occasional gales overnight.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the south of Iceland will drive a frontal tough across the area tonight


##Wind##

South or Southeast 6 or 7 occasionally gale 8, but veering and decreasing West or Northwest 3 or 4 over western and central parts later tonight or tomorrow morning, but staying Southeast 5 or 6 in east of area. Becoming Variable 2 to 4 in all waters during afternoon and evening.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, falling slight or moderate tomorrow.


##Weather##

Rain, clearing later tonight or tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4, settling Southeast and increasing 5 to 7 for a time on Saturday, veering West or Southwest 4 or 5 later in day.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate or rough for a time.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.
